title: Never Find Your Value In Your Position
text: you know if you get your value from what you do and who you are as a position you better never lose your position if your significance comes from your title you better never get fired a leader has found value in herself she brings value to the position and when she leaves they miss her am i talking to anyone here tell your neighbor when I leave you're gonna miss me clap your hands right there that's a good place to clap see if you if you bring value to the job you're gonna be the last one they want to get rid of and if you leave they all wish you stayed
